lessons_used: Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after adoption) was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).

Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), whereas static time estimates and error safeguards on the same screen showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides and notification prompts) showed no clear effect, and predictions were set too high.
Adoption grid layout changes showed no clear effect, with predictions (+15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Copy adjustments for path selection showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact (+8.0%).
Account sync safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions (+3.0%) being too high.

candidates.title: Photo Upload Step Card Layout Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the photo upload screen into a structured card layout with custom photo picker controls to make pet photo submission smooth.
candidates.why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate in the funnel at 60.9% and a high mean time of 1017s, plus support received 3 tickets about custom pet generation failures.

guard.reason: Redesigns photo upload screen into a card layout without removing required functionality.

candidates.score_note: Target step has highest dropoff and support tickets, but layout redesigns historically showed low impact.

candidates.title: Defer Account Sign-In To Onboarding Finish
candidates.change: Move the sign-in step to the very end of onboarding after the pet setup and home welcome screens are complete.
candidates.why: Moving sign-in later previously increased conversion by +16.8%, and 8 support emails noted account sync issues during early sign-in.

guard.reason: home_intro must come after every existing screen, sign_in included

candidates.title: Live Pet Generation Animation Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated pet hatching animation screen right before waiting to build excitement during setup.
candidates.why: Home wait time is 201s median / 2336s mean, and previous live visualizer experiments significantly outperformed predictions (+9.3%).

guard.reason: _order leaves out existing screens ['sign_in']: no step may be removed

candidates.title: Split Path Selection Experience
candidates.change: Redesign path selection into a side-by-side split view comparing instant adoptable pets against custom photo pets.
candidates.why: Choose path has a high mean duration of 514s and a 76.2% conversion rate, indicating decision friction early on.

guard.reason: replacement for 'choose_path.path_options' does not do the job (two distinct choices: adopting a friend and making your own): needs 2 of ['button', 'choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Interactive Mascot Progress Updates
candidates.change: Add an animated mascot helper and step counter to the waiting screen while pet generation finishes.
candidates.why: Live progress visualizers on waiting screens previously boosted conversion by +9.3% and high waiting times (median 201s) need engagement.

components.text: Your pet is coming to life on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adds progress updates to the waiting screen while fulfilling its core function.

candidates.score_note: Live progress visualizers on waiting screens consistently outperform predictions.

candidates.title: Account Recovery & Sync Helper Hint
candidates.change: Add a clear explanatory hint on the sign-in screen informing users that signing in preserves their pet across re-installs.
candidates.why: 8 support tickets were submitted regarding pets missing or reset after signing in again.

sign_in.hint: Sign in with your main account to ensure your pet progress is saved safely.

guard.reason: Adds an explanatory hint to the sign-in screen.

candidates.score_note: Strong support email signal; explanatory hints historically produce moderate positive lift.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Confirmation Headline Redesign
candidates.change: Update adoption certificate copy with celebratory text and a prominent button to complete adoption.
candidates.why: Adoption drops off significantly with only 60.9% conversion and long completion times.

adoption_certificate.headline: Official Pet Adoption Certificate
adoption_certificate.body: Your new desktop friend is ready to move in. Click below to confirm adoption!

guard.reason: Updates copy on the adoption certificate screen while preserving its core function.

candidates.score_note: High dropoff step, but simple copy adjustments have shown almost no effect in past tests.

candidates.title: First-Day Desktop Owner Badge Prompt
candidates.change: Display a celebratory owner badge component on the home intro screen upon completing setup.
candidates.why: Finish step dropoff is high at 64.8% conversion and median completion takes 395s.

guard.reason: Adds an owner badge to the home intro screen within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Finish screen additions and prompts have historically shown negative or flat results.

candidates.title: Desktop Launch Arrival Celebration Screen
candidates.change: Add a dedicated celebration screen after home intro showing a preview video of the pet arriving live on the desktop.
candidates.why: Finish step drops to 64.8% and 3 support emails reported confusion about pet not appearing on desktop.

guard.reason: _order leaves out existing screens ['sign_in']: no step may be removed

candidates.title: Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Story
candidates.change: Change story screen layout to story_scroll with a calm descriptive text component.
candidates.why: Choose path mean duration is 514s, showing users take a long time to navigate initial app context.

components.text: Discover cute pets that stay right on your desktop while you work.

guard.reason: Redesigns the story screen layout while continuing to introduce the pet.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high step duration, but path selection layout changes have shown minimal impact.

picked: Photo Upload Step Card Layout Redesign
Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Story

decisions.title: Photo Upload Step Card Layout Redesign
Story Scroll Layout for Welcome Story

lessons_next: Reordering onboarding steps (moving sign-in after adoption) was helpful and exceeded predictions (+16.8% measured vs +12.0% predicted).

Live progress visualizers on the waiting screen were helpful and far exceeded predictions (+9.3% measured vs +2.0% predicted), whereas static time estimates, safeguards, and mascot updates showed no clear effect.
Finish screen additions (control guides, notification prompts, owner badges) showed no clear effect, and predictions were set too high.
Adoption step layout changes and redesigns showed no clear effect, with predictions (up to +15.0%) being overly optimistic.
Path selection copy and layout adjustments showed no clear effect, over-predicting impact.
Sign-in hints and safeguard warnings showed no clear effect, with predictions set too high.
